b2-20-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The New Museum
b2-20-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks when the new museum is going to open. You know it will be officially opened next week.
b2-20-01.prompt: Tell Carlos when the museum will be opened.
cues: Say that the museum will be opened officially
b2-20-01.target: El museo será inaugurado la semana próxima.
b2-20-01.english: The museum will be opened next week.
b2-20-01.canDo: I can use the passive with *ser* in the preterite, the present perfect and the future.

b2-20-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Built the Bridge
b2-20-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks you who built the new bridge. You know that a local company built it.
b2-20-02.prompt: Tell Meg who built the bridge.
cues: Say that the bridge was built
b2-20-02.target: El puente fue construido por una empresa local.
b2-20-02.english: The bridge was built by a local company.
b2-20-02.canDo: I can name the doer of a passive with *por* when it is important.

b2-20-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Closed Restaurant
b2-20-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos wants to eat at the restaurant near the office. You know it was closed on Monday and it is still closed.
b2-20-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what happened to the restaurant and what its situation is now.
cues: Say that it is still closed
b2-20-03.target: El restaurante fue cerrado el lunes y todavía está cerrado.
b2-20-03.english: The restaurant was closed on Monday and it is still closed.
b2-20-03.canDo: I can use *estar* + participle to describe the result of an action.

b2-20-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Printed Report
b2-20-04.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks if the report is ready. You have already printed it.
b2-20-04.prompt: Tell Meg that you have printed the report.
cues: Say that you have already printed it
Say that it is ready on paper
b2-20-04.target: Ya he imprimido el informe y está impreso en papel.
b2-20-04.english: I have already printed the report and it is printed on paper.
b2-20-04.canDo: I can use the regular participle after *haber* with *imprimir*, *freír*, *proveer* and *elegir*.

b2-20-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Statement
b2-20-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks who wrote the statement about the new agreement. The mayor wrote it and it is already published.
b2-20-05.prompt: Tell Carlos who wrote the statement and what its situation is now.
cues: Say that it is already published
b2-20-05.target: El comunicado fue redactado por el alcalde y ya está publicado.
b2-20-05.english: The statement was written by the mayor and it is already published.
b2-20-05.canDo: I can choose between an active verb, the passive with *ser*, passive *se* and *estar* + participle.

b2-20-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: A Novel by Arguedas
b2-20-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks what you read about Alcides Arguedas. You read that his novel was published in 1919 and is considered the first text of Bolivian indigenismo.
b2-20-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg what you read about the novel.
cues: Say when the novel was published
b2-20-consolidation.target: La novela fue publicada en 1919 y es considerada el primer texto del indigenismo boliviano.
b2-20-consolidation.english: The novel was published in 1919 and it is considered the first text of Bolivian indigenismo.
b2-20-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short text about Alcides Arguedas and his novel Raza de bronce.
